questions.title: Most Frequent Character
questions.description:
Read a single line of text and print the character that occurs **most often** in it.

### Input
One line containing only letters (uppercase and/or lowercase), with no spaces. The line has at least one character.

### Output
A single character: the one that appears the most times in the line.

### Rules
- **Case matters.** `'a'` and `'A'` are counted as two different characters.
- **Tie-break:** if two or more characters occur the same (maximum) number of times, print whichever of them appears **first** (leftmost) in the original line.

### Example
Input:
```
aabbbcc
```
Counts: `a` → 2, `b` → 3, `c` → 2. `b` occurs the most times (3), so:

Output:
```
b
```

### Tie example
Input:
```
abab
```
`a` and `b` both occur twice, but `a` appears first in the string, so:

Output:
```
a
```

testCases.description: normal case, one clear majority character
tie between two characters, broken by earliest first appearance
three-way tie, broken by earliest first appearance
case sensitivity: uppercase and lowercase are different characters
longer input with a clear winner
